sentences.en: Many ethnic groups traditionally give money as a wedding gift.
sentences.zh: 许多少数民族传统上会赠送金钱作为婚礼礼物。

sentences.en: Traditionally on April 1st, people pull pranks on each other.
sentences.zh: 传说在4月1日，人们互相恶作剧。

sentences.en: In Britain, mince pies are traditionally eaten at Christmas time.
sentences.zh: 在英国，肉馅派通常在圣诞节期间食用。
